source: DualSPHysics v5.4 (Dominguez et al. 2022), pySurf's reference run of the Surf Ranch reef turned 25 degrees at 32 particles per depth (dualSphysics/tools/reefRuns.py, in the repository's history to commit 27c0a03; 2026-11-09), measured with pySurf's breaking tracker under decision 14 of the GPU SPH roadmap. A cross-check: no measurement exists for this tank.
tank: Flat at h0 offshore; the 0.0693 face from the toe at x = 30 + y tan 25 h0 to a shelf 0.371 h0 deep; the shelf to an end wall at x = 52 h0; 4 h0 across between free-slip walls (mDBC slip mode 3). A piston tuned so the gauge at x = 20 h0 reads H/h0 = 0.6 within 0.8 percent.
times: seconds after the crest passes the gauge at x = 20 h0, with h0 = 1 m
note: The wall sections, y = 0 and 4 h0, read breaking at the toe: artifacts of the wall rows, left out of the crossing speed.
